failure_modes_match: exact set: run.json failure_modes, sorted, must equal this list
must_mention_in: report.md written by the run (case-sensitive substring match)
intended_by: corpus author; written before the recorded run, not copied from it
note: A stored summary claims PASS for an input that has a header and zero data records. A conforming verifier must not confirm that PASS: it abstains because no row was examined, and names the vacuous pass.

recorded_run.note: The recorded run (science-gate 0.1.0, commit 7ec36c6) matches status, exit_code and reason. Its failure_modes are [PARTIAL_EXECUTION, VACUOUS_PASS], and its report.md does not contain 'rows_examined'. Both differences are recorded in entry.json known_failures. The intended values above were not edited to match the run.

does_not_prove: Reproducing this outcome shows conformance on this declared synthetic fixture only.
It does not show that the verifier catches failures outside the corpus.
It does not show that any scientific conclusion is true, and it does not show fitness for any use.
